# Proposal for Exhibition Renewal at the [Museum Name]

## Introduction

This proposal outlines a practical plan to refresh our permanent galleries over the coming year. It responds to two pressures we all recognise: our displays have grown crowded and object-heavy over decades of accumulation, and our audiences increasingly ask not "what is this?" but "whose was it, and how did they use it?" At the same time, we must be honest about our constraints. Our budget is limited, our volunteers give what time they can, and we want to avoid the trap of turning every exhibit into a screen. What follows is a plan built around a few clear priorities and the compromises they require.

## Priority One: Fewer Objects, Richer Stories

Our galleries currently present visitors with a dense wall-to-wall experience. Well-intentioned accumulation has left little room for reflection, and the sheer volume of material means most items receive only a label, if that.
